title: I made a browser-based low-poly tactical FPS inspired by Counter-Strike 1.5
author: MR1933
selftext:
I built a browser-based low-poly FPS, mostly as a stress test for an autonomous coding framework I’m working on.



The game itself is inspired by the pacing and feel of old Counter-Strike 1.5-era tactical FPS matches.



About 90% of the game was implemented by the framework workflow with only the higher level goal of building a low-poly cs 1.5 like browser game and, more importantly, describing the aceptance criteria.



This initial commit took about 4 hours of gpt-5.5, completely autonomous. 

  

The rest was back-and-forth with Codex to tighten rough edges, fix bugs, tune bots, etc...



It is rough, but surprisingly fun to play while codex is building. 



Link to game and repo in comments.



I’d love feedback on either side: the game feel itself, or the idea of using a real playable game as a benchmark for autonomous software-building agents.
